testCases.title: Dashboard loads without errors
testCases.objective: Verify the Home dashboard renders all sections on first load
steps: 3. Check all summary cards are visible
4. Open browser console and verify no errors
testCases.expectedResult: Dashboard renders. Net Worth, Income, Expense, Savings cards visible. No console errors.

steps: 2. Note the Net Worth value on dashboard
testCases.expectedResult: hNet on dashboard matches netWorth in iVault Overview. Value is never ₹0 unless all assets are zero.

testCases.title: Bottom navigation switches modules correctly
testCases.objective: Verify all 5 bottom nav tabs navigate to correct modules. Reminders is no longer a nav tab — it is accessed via the header bell icon (🔔).
steps: 6. Tap the bell icon (🔔) in the header
testCases.expectedResult: Each of the 5 nav tabs shows the correct module. Active tab is highlighted. Bell icon opens the reminder panel. No blank screens.

testCases.title: Recent activity section displays latest transactions
testCases.objective: Verify recent activity shows the most recent financial entries
steps: 3. Verify entries are sorted by date descending
testCases.expectedResult: Most recent transactions appear first. Date, amount, and category are visible.

testCases.title: Upcoming reminders shown on dashboard
testCases.objective: Verify upcoming reminders appear on the Home dashboard
preconditions: At least one upcoming reminder exists
testCases.expectedResult: Upcoming reminders visible on dashboard with due date and title.

testCases.title: iVault Overview loads and shows financial summary
testCases.objective: Verify Overview tab renders net worth, assets, liabilities correctly
testCases.expectedResult: Net Worth = Total Assets - Total Liabilities. No console errors. No ₹0 shown incorrectly.

testCases.title: iVault refresh does not show error toast
testCases.objective: Verify the iVault refresh does not show 'iVault could not be refreshed' toast on normal load

testCases.title: Monthly Income displayed correctly
testCases.objective: Verify mIncome element shows correct current month income total
preconditions: At least one income transaction in current month
testCases.expectedResult: mIncome matches sum of current month income transactions.

testCases.title: Monthly Expense displayed correctly
testCases.objective: Verify mExpense element shows correct current month expense total
preconditions: At least one expense transaction in current month
testCases.expectedResult: mExpense matches sum of current month expense transactions.

testCases.objective: Verify mSavings = mIncome - mExpense
preconditions: Income and expense transactions exist for current month
testCases.expectedResult: mSavings equals mIncome minus mExpense. Negative savings shown correctly.

testCases.title: Add income transaction
testCases.objective: Verify a new income transaction can be created and saved
preconditions: At least one bank account exists
testCases.expectedResult: Income saved. Appears in list. Bank balance increases. mIncome updates.

testCases.title: Edit income transaction
testCases.objective: Verify an existing income transaction can be edited

testCases.expectedResult: Income updated. New amount reflected. Bank balance adjusted accordingly.

testCases.title: Delete income transaction

testCases.title: Add expense transaction
testCases.objective: Verify a new expense transaction can be created
preconditions: At least one bank account with sufficient balance
testCases.expectedResult: Expense saved. Bank balance decreases by expense amount. mExpense updates.

testCases.title: Bank balance decreases on expense
testCases.objective: Verify bank balance decreases exactly by expense amount
preconditions: Bank account with known balance exists
steps: 2. Add expense of ₹5000 from that bank
testCases.expectedResult: Bank balance = previous balance - 5000. Exact decrease, no rounding errors.

testCases.title: Edit expense transaction
testCases.objective: Verify an existing expense can be edited
preconditions: At least one expense transaction exists
testCases.expectedResult: Expense updated. Bank balance re-adjusted to reflect new amount.

testCases.title: Delete expense transaction
testCases.objective: Verify an expense transaction can be deleted
preconditions: At least one expense transaction exists
testCases.expectedResult: Expense deleted. Bank balance restored.

testCases.title: Create monthly budget
testCases.objective: Verify a new budget can be created for the current month
testCases.expectedResult: Budget saved. Values persist after reopen. No console error. Month format is YYYY-MM.

testCases.title: Edit existing budget
testCases.objective: Verify budget values can be edited and saved
preconditions: A budget exists for current month
testCases.expectedResult: Updated budget values saved and displayed correctly.

testCases.title: Delete budget
testCases.objective: Verify a budget record can be deleted

testCases.title: Previous month navigation shows correct budget

preconditions: Budgets exist for at least 2 consecutive months
steps: 5. Verify values are not stale from current month
testCases.expectedResult: Previous month budget shown with correct values. Data re-fetched from storage, not stale.

testCases.title: Next month navigation shows correct budget
testCases.objective: Verify Next button loads the correct next month budget with fresh data
preconditions: Budget exists for current and next month
testCases.expectedResult: Next month budget shown with correct values. Data re-fetched from storage.

testCases.title: Budgeted vs Actual comparison
testCases.objective: Verify budget shows actual spending vs budgeted amount per category
preconditions: Budget and expense transactions exist for same month
steps: 3. Verify Budgeted column matches saved budget
4. Verify Actual column matches sum of expenses in that category
testCases.expectedResult: Budgeted vs Actual correctly calculated per category. Overspend highlighted.

testCases.title: Budget pie chart renders
testCases.objective: Verify budget pie chart renders without errors
testCases.expectedResult: Pie chart renders. Segments proportional to category amounts. No console errors.

steps: 1. Create a budget for current month

testCases.expectedResult: Each past month shows its own saved budget. No cross-month data bleed.
